Collection Description
CRUD API test suite against JSONPlaceholder (https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com), covering positive and negative cases with assertions on status code, response schema, and response time. Built as a QA portfolio project. Note: JSONPlaceholder is a simulator — POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE requests are not actually persisted server-side. Responses reflect what a real API *would* return, which is documented inline where behavior differs from a real backend (e.g. writes to nonexistent IDs still return 200 instead of 404).
